primary_panel.rule: Neotoma coverage can never add, remove, backfill, reweight or split primary-panel insects or hosts.

dataset.rationale: These are the two Neotoma proxy types that can directly document past host-plant occurrence; other proxies cannot enter this validation.

time.label: Last Glacial Maximum broad window
time.prehistoric_host_association_interpretat: The modern HOSTS association is not evidence that the same insect-host interaction existed at 21 ka; Neotoma pollen and macrofossils establish host lineage presence only.

taxonomy.exact_species_evidence: accepted WCVP host species name matched to a Neotoma taxon at species rank; strongest direct validation tier
taxonomy.genus_evidence: accepted WCVP host genus matched to Neotoma genus-level or unresolved-within-genus plant taxon; secondary validation tier

coverage_census.unit: distinct Neotoma sites with at least one taxon occurrence inside the frozen LGM window
coverage_census.deduplication: one presence per taxon x site regardless of sample count

labels.exact_species_supported: >=3 distinct LGM sites for exact accepted host species
labels.genus_supported: >=5 distinct LGM sites for accepted host genus
labels.sparse: positive records below the applicable support threshold

coverage_census.role: coverage characterization only; thresholds do not gate or subset the primary genetic analysis

direct_validation.primary_model_unchanged: CHELSA-current niche envelope projected unchanged to CHELSA-TraCE21k 21 ka remains the primary host-history exposure.
permitted_outputs: counts of exact-species and genus-level LGM records/sites
maps overlaying fixed LGM host-suitability surfaces and independent Neotoma sites
predeclared descriptive suitability values at Neotoma sites
forbidden: select a favourable host species, insect subgroup, fossil-rich region or alternative LGM window
replace the primary CHELSA-derived exposure with Neotoma only after seeing genetic results
use Neotoma coverage to remove insects from the 135-species primary panel
treat genus-level fossil evidence as proof that the exact accepted host species occupied that site

next_step: Run response-blind Neotoma coverage census on the frozen host list, while independently starting the frozen native-range GBIF host occurrence gate.
